## THE HEADLINE IS REASSURING (recorded for trust — this is the surface that matters for a multi-tenant cutover)
All 11 controls ENFORCED, verified live:
1. X-Namespace role-gated (agent/readonly/promoter/discord/user -> 403 "Role not permitted to delegate namespace"; admin/ob-admin 200) — mutation-proven load-bearing (if(false) mutant BOUND an agent token to victim ns; repo untouched).
2. Delegation confines a GLOBAL admin (admin+X-Namespace reading foreign rows scoped correctly; cross-ns delegated read -> "Entry not found").
3. Wildcard cannot erase scope (delegated 'all'/'collab' -> literal "cannot read namespace 'all'", not unfiltered).
4. Session reuse binds effective identity (reuse under different identity -> 403 "Request identity does not match session").
5. IDOR on a real foreign row: read/update/archive all denied; admin control reads it; DB verified unmodified.
6. Cross-namespace writes refused (agent->bilby "agent role cannot write to namespace 'bilby'"; own-ns control succeeds — discriminates).
7. Table names Zod-enum validated (pg_shadow, "thoughts; DROP TABLE", "thoughts--" all refused; thoughts accepted).
8. Namespace enumeration scoped (user 2, admin 623). Constant-time token match (timingSafeEqual, length-first, no early break). REST role gate server-side.

Bottom line from the auditor: the boundary held against every violation constructed. The two items below are what keep it from "airtight," neither an isolation bypass.

## SHOULD-FIX
S1 — **The SERVING delegation gate has zero test coverage.** rg 'auth/middleware' --glob '**/*.test.ts' -> nothing. All three "Role not permitted to delegate namespace" assertions are in src/auth.test.ts (the LEGACY tree). The live process runs server/main.ts -> server/auth/middleware.ts:284. The two impls currently agree, but a regression in the SERVED one is invisible to CI. Also: delegateNamespace() (namespace-policy.ts:67-74) has ZERO production callers — the middleware inlines its own logic; tests exercise the uncalled function. Same two-serving-trees theme as #674. FIX: a test that exercises server/auth/middleware.ts directly.

S2 — **X-Agent-Id is not role-gated** (middleware.ts:90-93 shape-validates, accepts from any role, unlike X-Namespace). Flows to langfuse caller_agent_id, rest.ts audit agent_id, session-manager. Any token can stamp an arbitrary agent id onto audit/trace records. Never reaches a namespace predicate — attribution FORGERY, not isolation bypass. FIX: role-gate or bind X-Agent-Id to the token identity.

## FALSE CLAIM (operator ruling needed — do NOT silently fix)
S3 — docs/sme/security.md:196-221 says the promote/demote role asymmetry is "Status: fixed in PR #235." It is NOT fixed in the live path: src/rest-promotion.ts:69-71 allows admin|ob-admin|promoter to PROMOTE, :146 restricts DEMOTE to admin|ob-admin (demote-entry.ts:29 matches). docs/decisions/admin-and-promoter-identities.md:41 says "promotion archives and demotes." Live: promoter -> "Permission denied: admin or ob-admin role required." Either the doc or the gate is wrong. The asymmetry is RUNNING; the "fixed" label is false. Needs a ruling: is promoter supposed to be able to demote or not? Then fix the code or the SME entry to match — not silently.
